items.text: Caleb Williams officially OUT Monday vs PHI (hamstring); Tyson Bagent QUESTIONABLE after clearing steps to practice but not fully cleared protocol.
items.why: Hamstring; Bagent full participant but consecutive symptom-free days needed.
items.implication: Bears offense limited; Odunze/Burden/Loveland ceilings capped if Bagent starts.
items.opportunity: Possible Bagent start elevates checkdowns to TEs/RBs.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (left elbow dislocation); not on IR, Mariota to start; longer-term positive but multi-week absence.
items.why: Dislocated elbow (repeat of prior); Rapoport notes not IR, specialist consult, possible Weeks 5-6 return.
items.implication: Commanders offense downgraded; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Mariota game-script dependent; McLaurin historical with Mariota ~25% share.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday Night vs DEN (hip/groin); did not practice all week and not expected to play per multiple reports.
items.why: Hip/groin; limited progress per McVay; Schefter notes possible Week 4 return.
items.implication: Adams elevated target/routes share; Kyren still lead back.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams routes/target rate spike without Nacua (historical 42% target rate on routes alone).

items.text: Nico Collins OUT for Week 3 (hamstring); missed practice all week, second straight absence.
items.why: Hamstring strain; Schefter lists among Sunday outs.
items.implication: Schultz continues elevated target share (28-30% routes last week).
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz high target rate and TE-friendly Colts matchup.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe/boot); Jaylen Warren QUESTIONABLE (shoulder) but projected IN and will lead Steelers RBs with checkdown upside.
items.why: Toe aggravated; coach: Warren leads group, breathers for freshness; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.implication: Warren volume spike + Rodgers checkdowns if vertical fails.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + pass-game work; high snap share expected.

items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go Monday vs CHI; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Cleared fully; Rapoport confirms Saquon/DeVonta good.
items.implication: Full Eagles skill-group strength vs Bears backup QB likely.
items.opportunity: Barkley goal-line/ dual-threat; Smith routes vs weaker secondary.

items.text: Alec Pierce placed on IR (heel); Colts elevate Nick Westbrook-Ikhine and sign Gould.
items.why: Heel injury; official IR move confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Josh Downs target share jump (already 36% after Pierce exit prior); perimeter routes expand.
items.opportunity: Downs no longer slot-only; higher aDOT opportunity.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect heavy checkdowns from Rodgers as vertical game has failed; Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups.
items.why: Coach quote + usage vacuum; vertical inefficiency forces short game.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with PPR upside in volume spot.
items.opportunity: Lead snaps, carries, checkdown targets, third-down work.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected/placed on IR (groin); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead RB with AJ Dillon backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: Groin reinjury; only 5 career games; Hubbard RB14 utilization already.
items.implication: Hubbard locked into lead role and RB2/flex every-week starter.
items.opportunity: Full lead back snaps/carries/red-zone in CAR offense.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% team target share last week sans Collins; IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs; 30% route targets.
items.why: Usage spike confirmed + matchup; 10 Facts + Love/Hate.
items.implication: Top TE streamer/start with Collins out again.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes, red-zone in Collins vacuum.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram with 42% target rate; prior misses produced big games (5-35-3, 8-195-2).
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua sidelined.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside SNF if Nacua out/doubtful holds.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes, targets, red-zone share without Nacua.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (avg of top 25th-percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceilings; Lions home vs Jets strong scoring outlook + pass-catching role.
items.implication: Elite weekly upside play; smash spot for tournaments/DFS.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup + volume prop; feed him.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone share vs soft front.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit targets both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs). Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs 55 rush ypg/3.2 YPC).
items.why: Olave volume + aDOT vs soft secondary; Stevenson role/snap erosion + tough matchup. Also notes Henderson 65% snaps post-fumble but still ranks Stevenson ahead.
items.implication: Olave strong WR2/3 start; fade/sit Stevenson or flex only if desperate.
items.opportunity: Olave: high targets/air yards; Stevenson: reduced snaps/touches vs Henderson.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson despite usage shift.
